name: Famous Fables: Read, Learn and Play
source:
An educational game where young learners can strengthen their reading, spelling, and math skills while exploring the beloved story of The Tortoise and the Hare.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=53741]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
这是一款教育游戏，年轻学习者可以在探索深受喜爱的龟兔赛跑故事的同时，增强他们的阅读、拼写和数学技能。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=53741]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
